description: Binary assertions for DOCX report generation quality. Used by Karpathy-style self-improvement loop.

tests.prompt: Generate a one-page auction analysis report for case 2024-CA-003456 with BID recommendation.
tests.expected_output: DOCX with house brand colors, fonts, and branding

assertions.description: Header contains navy color #1E3A5F (hex in DOCX XML)
Font family is Arial (per DOCX color theme spec)
Document contains 'BidDeed.AI' branding text
Document does NOT contain 'Property360', 'Mariam', or 'Protection Partners'
Document does NOT contain 'BrevardBidderAI' (deprecated brand)

tests.prompt: Generate landscape-oriented auction summary report for 10 cases.
tests.expected_output: Valid DOCX file in landscape orientation

assertions.description: DOCX file passes python-docx/pandoc validation (no corruption)
Page orientation is LANDSCAPE (width > height in section properties)
File size is > 5KB (not empty/stub)
Document contains at least one table element
No unicode bullet characters (must use LevelFormat.BULLET)

tests.prompt: Generate a report with BID recommendation containing practice/skip/shabbat color-coded sections.
tests.expected_output: DOCX with correct color theme per memory spec

assertions.description: BID/Practice sections use green background E8F5E9
SKIP sections use red background FFEBEE
Header uses navy 1E3A5F
Uses ShadingType.CLEAR (no SOLID shading causing black backgrounds)
Table cells have margins (not zero-padding)

tests.prompt: Generate report for case with ARV=$350K, Repairs=$40K, Judgment=$180K. Verify all calculated fields.
tests.expected_output: Report with correct max bid, bid ratio, and recommendation

assertions.description: Report shows bid/judgment ratio (152500/180000 = 0.847 or 84.7%)
Recommendation is BID (ratio 0.847 >= 0.75 threshold)
Report contains case_number field
Report contains ML prediction section with percentage or score

tests.prompt: Generate report for case with $0 repairs and missing BCPAO photo. Verify graceful handling.
tests.expected_output: Valid report handling zero/null values without errors

assertions.description: DOCX is valid even with $0 repairs (no division by zero or NaN)
Report does NOT contain 'NaN', 'undefined', 'null', or 'None' as visible text
Missing photo shows placeholder text or 'No photo available' (not broken image)
Max bid is calculated correctly with $0 repairs
Document renders to at least 1 page (not empty)
